scripts.build: npm run build -w create-graph-app && npm run build -w @graph-engineering/contracts && npm run build -w @graph-engineering/engine && npm run build -w @graph-engineering/dashboard
scripts.build:dependencies: npm run build -w create-graph-app && npm run build -w @graph-engineering/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:dependencies && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:dependencies && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write packages scripts evaluation .github .graph/project.json package.json tsconfig.base.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages scripts evaluation .github .graph/project.json package.json tsconfig.base.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs
